coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed with 12 targeted web searches covering only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss; storm/flood/fire/outage/facility-damage-related food-distribution cancellations; abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major service reduction; and official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences. No new qualifying disruption since the prior hourly check was verified. Hawai'i Island Food Basket warehouse closures remained a previously known storm-related signal; Kaua'i recovery reporting described replacement-SNAP support and power restoration rather than a new assistance interruption; and Hatteras Island road isolation was not retained because reviewed reporting did not directly document a new grocery-store loss, food-distribution cancellation, pantry closure, or official benefit interruption. Donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine promotion, generic inflation coverage, unsupported social claims, and duplicates were excluded.
